convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI' custom indicator and includes TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_). Custom indicator cannot be directly replicated in Python without its source.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: When RVI line is above Signal line (Line1[1]>Line2[1]), Sell positions are closed if SellPosClose input is true; When RVI line is below Signal line (Line1[1]<Line2[1]), Buy positions are closed if BuyPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM input: if MMMode=LOT then MM is fixed lot size; if MMMode=PERCENT then MM is percentage of deposit. Negative MM values may indicate fixed lots in TradeAlgorithms.mqh convention.

custom_logic_notes: Signal detection uses bar[1] vs bar[0] comparison: Line1[1]>Line2[1] means RVI was above Signal on previous bar, then checks Line1[0]<=Line2[0] for crossover entry. SignalBar input defaults to 1, but when SignalBar==0 it processes every tick without new-bar guard. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) are computed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec and passed to trade functions, likely used for pending order placement or signal expiration in TradeAlgorithms.mqh. Recount flag forces re-evaluation if CopyBuffer fails. The i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI is a spectral analysis variant of RVI (Relative Vigor Index) using FFT-based decomposition with N=7 length and SS=20 smoothing.
python_conversion_notes: The i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is a spectral analysis variant of RVI using parameters RVIPeriod=14, N=7 (FFT length), SS=20 (smoothing). The standard RVI can be computed via ta-lib but the spectral decomposition is custom. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles position open/close with money management - need to reimplement BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/SellPositionClose/BuyPositionClose with same MMMode logic (LOT vs PERCENT sizing). SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely need 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10 if _Digits==5). New-bar guard and SignalBar offset logic is straightforward to port. Signal timestamps passed to trade functions may be for order expiration - verify in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
